# Assessments

The Fall 2026 syllabus does not list midterm or final examinations. Course points come from four homework assignments and in-class quizzes, with optional extra credit from Homework 0.

<div class="agst-index-grid">
<div class="agst-index-card"><span>80 POINTS</span><h3>Homework</h3><p>Four graded assignments worth approximately 20 points each</p></div>
<div class="agst-index-card"><span>20 POINTS</span><h3>In-class quizzes</h3><p>Brief quizzes that may be given during in-person class meetings</p></div>
<div class="agst-index-card"><span>+2 POSSIBLE</span><h3>Extra credit</h3><p>Optional Homework 0</p></div>
</div>

## Quiz format

Quizzes may contain one to three questions, generally last five to ten minutes, and review recent material. Students should bring a laptop or mobile device. Attendance is required to earn quiz points, and missed quizzes cannot normally be made up.

| Percentage | A | B | C | D | F |
